sandbox.qualification: Pinned official defaults retained, including stock SwiftShader if observed; no custom GPU switch or hardware/kernel-isolation claim.

qualifications: Original saved aggregate JSON only; no model replay, new experiments/comparisons, generated cells, positions or full genomes.
Source producer world30/chamber1/dt30 remains separate from the current delivery HEAD/tree.
Exact integer comparisons use BigInt; mol/J plot values are derived exported displays, not an independent per-tick ledger proof.
Four Chromium viewport sizes and keyboard/select/history controls; no native touch/full accessibility/achieved FPS or kernel-isolation attestation.
An explicitly labelled whitespace-byte integrity negative control changes transport bytes only, preserving all JSON observations.

rawArithmetic.scope: Static exact-integer differences/missing pairs over exported samples; no browser/model/ledger recomputation

limitations: Uncalibrated prototype chemistry and bounded inherited kinetics.
No temperature dependence, spatial dynamics, GRN or open-ended evolution.
Finite horizons and resource stops are censored observations, not completed biological histories.
Samples contain aggregates, not resumable states or event reconstructions.

oracle.kind: Synthetic arithmetic/unknown-value controls, not biological observations
